tool_schemas.name: getVideoDetails
tool_schemas.description: Returns cached, normalized details for each requested YouTube video ID and (when requested) includes a metrics snapshot either for the latest known point or the snapshot closest to `metrics_at`; if `refresh` is true or an entry is older than `max_age_seconds`, we refetch and update our cache before responding. The response preserves the input order and returns per-video results (including missing/unavailable videos) rather than paging. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, empty lists, invalid timestamps, or conflicting metric options; UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the key lacks access, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller’s quota would be exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR / NOT_FOUND when YouTube reports the video is unavailable or does not exist and we have no cached record to serve.

video_ids.description: List of YouTube video IDs to fetch details for.

refresh.description: If true, refreshes cached video data from YouTube before returning.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds; older entries will be refreshed.

include_metrics.description: If true, includes the latest cached metrics snapshot for each video.

metrics_at.description: If provided, returns the metrics snapshot closest to this timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: searchVideos
tool_schemas.description: Searches for videos matching `query`, returning a page of result items (video entities with basic metadata) ordered by `order_by`, filtered by the optional channel/time window, and biased by `region_code`, `language`, and `safe_search`; results are paged with `limit` and an opaque `cursor` returned in the response for the next page. If `refresh` is true or any returned entities exceed `max_age_seconds`, we refresh those entities in the cache as needed before returning them. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty query, invalid region/language codes, invalid date ranges (e.g., `published_after` > `published_before`), or an invalid cursor; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for API key issues, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the request would exceed quota, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when YouTube search cannot be completed.

region_code.description: Two-letter region code to bias search results (e.g., US).

language.description: BCP-47 language code to bias results (e.g., en, en-US).

published_after.description: Only return videos published after this time.

published_before.description: Only return videos published before this time.

channel_id.description: Restrict results to a specific YouTube channel ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

refresh.description: If true, refreshes relevant cached entities from YouTube where needed.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds for video entities returned.

tool_schemas.name: getTranscripts
tool_schemas.description: Returns cached transcripts for each requested video ID, choosing the best match for `language` and `kind` when available and optionally including time-aligned segments when `include_segments` is true; if `refresh` is true or cached transcripts exceed `max_age_seconds`, we attempt to re-fetch and update the cache before responding. The response returns per-video transcript results (or per-video unavailability) and is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, empty lists, or invalid option values; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for API key issues, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when refresh/retrieval would exceed quota, NOT_FOUND when a video has no transcript record and none can be retrieved, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the transcript source cannot be reached or does not return captions.

video_ids.description: List of YouTube video IDs to retrieve transcripts for.

language.description: Preferred transcript language (BCP-47); falls back if unavailable.

include_segments.description: If true, includes time-aligned transcript segments when available.

refresh.description: If true, re-fetches transcripts from the source when possible.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds for transcript entries.

tool_schemas.name: getRelatedVideos
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of videos related to the given `video_id`, localized/biaised by `region_code` and `language`, with pagination via `limit` and an opaque `cursor` for subsequent pages. If `refresh` is true or cached entities exceed `max_age_seconds`, we refresh the seed video and related entities as needed before returning results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid video ID, invalid cursor, or out-of-range limits; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for API key issues, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when refresh would exceed quota, NOT_FOUND when the seed video cannot be found/served from cache, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when related results cannot be obtained from YouTube.

video_id.description: YouTube video ID to find related videos for.

region_code.description: Two-letter region code to localize related results.

language.description: BCP-47 language code to bias related results.

limit.description: Maximum number of related videos to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

refresh.description: If true, refreshes the seed video and related entities from YouTube where needed.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds for returned video entities.

tool_schemas.name: getChannelStatistics
tool_schemas.description: Returns cached channel statistics for each requested channel ID (including subscriber count, view count, and video count) and refreshes any channel older than `max_age_seconds` or all channels when `refresh` is true. The response is not paged and returns per-channel results for the input list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed channel IDs or empty lists; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for API key issues, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when refresh would exceed quota, NOT_FOUND when a channel does not exist and no cached entity is available, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when YouTube channel stats cannot be retrieved.

channel_ids.description: List of YouTube channel IDs to retrieve statistics for.

refresh.description: If true, refreshes cached channel entities from YouTube before returning.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds; older channel entries will be refreshed.

tool_schemas.name: getChannelTopVideos
tool_schemas.description: Returns a ranked list of a channel’s top videos (currently ranked by `view_count`) constrained by the optional publish window, with up to `limit` items and no cursor-based pagination. If `refresh` is true or any required entities/metrics exceed `max_age_seconds`, we refresh the channel, its video entities, and/or metrics snapshots as needed before ranking. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid channel ID, invalid publish window (e.g., `published_after` > `published_before`), or unsupported `order_by`; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for API key issues, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when refresh would exceed quota, NOT_FOUND when the channel cannot be found/served from cache, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the underlying channel/video data cannot be fetched.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel ID to retrieve top videos for.

limit.description: Maximum number of top videos to return.

order_by.description: Ranking metric for top videos (currently only view_count).

published_after.description: Only consider channel videos published after this time.

published_before.description: Only consider channel videos published before this time.

refresh.description: If true, refreshes channel and video entities/metrics from YouTube where needed.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds for video entities/metrics used.

tool_schemas.name: getVideoEngagementRatio
tool_schemas.description: Returns, for each requested video ID, the view/like/comment counts from the latest cached metrics snapshot (or the snapshot closest to `snapshot_at`) plus the computed engagement ratio, refreshing metrics first when `refresh` is true or snapshots exceed `max_age_seconds`. The response is not paged and returns per-video calculations for the input list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, empty lists, invalid timestamps, or unusable snapshot selection; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for API key issues, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when refresh would exceed quota, NOT_FOUND when no metrics snapshot exists and one cannot be fetched, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when YouTube metrics cannot be retrieved.

video_ids.description: List of YouTube video IDs to calculate engagement ratio for.

refresh.description: If true, refreshes metrics from YouTube before calculating.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds for metrics snapshots used.

snapshot_at.description: If provided, uses/returns the metrics snapshot closest to this timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: getTrendingVideos
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a paged list of currently trending videos for the specified `region_code` and optional `category_id`, returning up to `limit` items with an opaque `cursor` for subsequent pages; returned items include cached video entities and any associated cached metadata needed to serve the trending view. If `refresh` is true or cached entities exceed `max_age_seconds`, we refresh the relevant trending set and any stale video entities before responding. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid region codes, unsupported category IDs, invalid cursor, or out-of-range limits; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for API key issues, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when refresh would exceed quota, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when trending results cannot be obtained from YouTube for the requested region/category.

region_code.description: Two-letter region code to retrieve trending videos for (e.g., US).

category_id.description: YouTube video category ID to filter trending results.

limit.description: Maximum number of trending videos to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

refresh.description: If true, refreshes trending set and underlying entities from YouTube before returning.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds for trending results and entities.

tool_schemas.name: compareVideos
tool_schemas.description: Compares multiple videos based on their statistics. Returns a comparison of view counts, like counts, comment counts, and other metrics for the specified videos. Use this when you want to analyze the performance of multiple videos side by side.

video_ids.description: List of YouTube video IDs to compare side by side.

include_transcript.description: Whether to include cached transcript availability info for each video in the comparison.

freshness_max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable age (in seconds) of cached entities/metrics before the service refreshes from YouTube.

snapshot_at.description: Use metrics snapshot closest to this RFC3339 timestamp; if omitted, uses latest available snapshots.

metrics_source.description: Which metrics source to prefer when multiple are available in cache.

tool_schemas.name: createApiKey
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key record and returns the created api_keys row (including the generated plain-text key shown only once) or refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameters.

owner_type.description: Type of owner for this key.

owner_id.description: Identifier for the owning user/project/service in the caller's identity domain.

daily_quota_units.description: Per-UTC-day quota in YouTube quota units enforced by this service.

per_minute_request_limit.description: Rolling per-minute request limit enforced by this service.

tool_schemas.name: listApiKeys
tool_schemas.description: Lists api_keys visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status/owner, returning a page of results ordered by created_at descending; refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the caller cannot enumerate keys.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: updateApiKey
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an api_keys row and returns the updated record; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the key id does not exist or AUTH_ERROR if the caller lacks access.

api_key_id.description: Primary id of the api_keys row to update.

daily_quota_units.description: New per-UTC-day quota in YouTube quota units.

tool_schemas.name: setApiKeyStatus
tool_schemas.description: Transitions an api_keys row between lifecycle states (active, suspended, revoked) and returns the updated row; refuses with CONFLICT if the requested transition is not allowed.

api_key_id.description: Primary id of the api_keys row to transition.

reason.description: Optional audit note explaining why the status changed.

tool_schemas.name: listRequestLogs
tool_schemas.description: Lists request_logs for the caller's API key(s) with optional filtering by tool/status/time window, returning a paged result set; refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the caller is not allowed to view logs.

api_key_id.description: Filter logs to a specific api_keys.id.

tool_name.description: Filter by tool name (e.g., getVideoDetails, searchVideos).

created_after.description: Only return logs created at or after this timestamp (UTC).

created_before.description: Only return logs created before this timestamp (UTC).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getCaller
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for the presented API key; refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the credential is missing/invalid.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (plain-text key).
